screening_reasoning: A cyberinfrastructure study training ML models for crop growth-stage, soil-moisture, and yield prediction from UAS imagery; prediction/classification tasks, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
An instance-segmentation dataset of cabbages across the growing season annotated from UAV imagery, explicitly supporting UAV-based crop instance segmentation and monitoring.

Instance segmentation of maize seedling plants from UAV multispectral imagery evaluates six algorithms; YOLOv8 achieves segm_mAP50 94%, i.e., UAV crop pixel-level instance segmentation with quantitative segmentation metrics.
Uses VGG-16/CNN/FCN for plant-disease detection in UAV precision-agriculture; a disease-classification/detection task without crop/weed pixel-level segmentation benchmark.
Scale-aware CNN regression predicts cotton yield from UAV RGB imagery (R2 > 0.9); a yield-regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
CNN/PLSR/RF estimate winter-wheat leaf area index from UAV multispectral images; a trait-regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
Fine-tuned vision-transformer for plant-DISEASE detection/classification; a classification task without UAV aerial crop/weed segmentation.
CNN predicts tree-level almond yield from multispectral aerial imagery (R2 0.96); an orchard-fruit yield regression task outside crop/weed segmentation.
MPAPR R-CNN instance-segments apple-tree canopy in UAV imagery for variable-rate spraying; an orchard fruit-tree canopy task outside crop/weed management scope.
CoFly-WeedDB is a UAV RGB cotton-field dataset with expert polygon annotations of three weed species, explicitly built for automatic weed segmentation/classification from UAV imagery.
3D/2D CNNs predict field-scale rice yield and crop stress from multitemporal UAV imagery (RMSE); a yield/stress regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
Whole-field RL+CNN aerial scouting samples a corn field and predicts crop health via the excess-green index (89.8% accuracy); a field-scouting/prediction task, not crop/weed segmentation.
CNN recognizes individual rapeseed leaves in UAV imagery for stand-count estimation; a leaf-detection/counting task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
Semantic segmentation of tree branches in forest environments for UAV navigation/obstacle avoidance (Jetson Orin Nano, mIoU 89.94%); a forest-perception domain, not crop/weed management.
RFD-BiSeNet V2 segments floodwater for environmental disaster monitoring (USV/UAV); a flood-monitoring domain outside crop/weed agriculture.
Estimates noninvasive heart rate from 4K UAV videos using instance segmentation; a physiological/signals domain, unrelated to crop/weed segmentation.
Human detection/segmentation in UAV thermal imagery for search-and-rescue (Jetson AGX Orin); a SAR domain, not agricultural crop/weed segmentation.
VDP_UNet segments plateau zokor mounds in alpine meadows from UAV imagery; a grassland-rodent-control domain rather than crop/weed management.
Pruned U-Net segments levee defects for UAV infrastructure inspection (57.74 FPS); a civil-infrastructure domain, unrelated to crop/weed segmentation.
EfficientSegNet is a general-purpose lightweight semantic segmentation network for autodriving/surveillance/drone vision; no agricultural crop/weed segmentation context.
MSCL-SwinUNet performs MRI (medical) semantic segmentation; a medical-imaging domain unrelated to crop/weed agriculture.
An improved SegFormer segments UAV mine-restoration scenes (HNMUD); a mining/ecological-restoration domain, not crop/weed management.
RCANet segments pine trees affected by pine wood nematode from UAV imagery (83.14 FPS); a forest-pest domain outside crop/weed management.
STDC-CT recognizes UAV emergency landing zones via semantic segmentation (Jetson TX2); an urban/UAV-safety domain, not crop/weed segmentation.
Generative-AI (LLM/KG/simulator) farm-level advisory for rice systems; a natural-language advisory study, not a UAV crop/weed segmentation benchmark.
